thread:
elaine: Quick pulse — noticed a sharp drop in post-launch webinar -> lead conversion yesterday AM (was ~18% on Thu, fell to ~9% on Fri). Pulled the dashboard snapshot here: https://pulse.redwood/boards/launch-avalon (see 'webinar funnel' card). Anyone see routing changes, landing swaps, or promo copy flips? :eyes:

ravi: Noted. I can run a quick source breakdown. First thought: UTMs looked messy in last deploy. Will check raw event ingestion and hubspot join.

sophie: We didn't flip the primary CTA copy for the webinar, only the subject line variant (A/B) which historically moves opens not conversions. I can post the A/B readout but doubt it's that big.

mark: HubSpot workflows did have a small tweak on Friday evening to dedupe by email domain; shouldn't affect conversion rate but could affect counts. Also saw a redirect rule added to /webinars/registrations earlier in the week (cc @ops).

automation-bot: nightly-etl: webinar_events -> warehouse loaded (s3://redwood-exports/webinar_events/33344455_2026-03-20.csv). row_count=4892; status=SUCCESS :white_check_mark:

ravi: quick ad-hoc check — runsql: ```sql
SELECT utm_source, count(*) as hits, sum(converted) as leads
FROM raw.webinar_events
WHERE event_date >= '2026-03-18' AND event_date <= '2026-03-20'
GROUP BY utm_source
ORDER BY hits DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

ravi: result (top rows):
- (null): hits=412, leads=3
- google-cpc: hits=2310, leads=210
- partner-newsletter: hits=1215, leads=105
- internal-email: hits=955, leads=83
Looks like an uptick in null UTMs on Friday which depresses measured conversion rate in the dashboard.

sophie: hmm — where are those nulls coming from? could be social preview links or a mis-tagged organic push. We did a Twitter thread Friday morning that used the short link short.red/xyz — maybe that lost UTM.

mark: also worth checking inbound routing rules — if leads from null source are getting tagged to a low-touch owner bucket they might be filtered out of the funnel metric we show on the board.

elaine: action items: 1) ravi to run a headless crawl of the short link and confirm missing utm/redirect chain; 2) mark to audit HubSpot routing for Fri 03/20 00:00-12:00; 3) sophie to pull A/B result and timestamp social posts. Can we reconvene in 15? I'll update the pulseboard and tag snapshot as "benchline-signal". :spiral_calendar:

ravi: on it — quick redirect trace output:
```
short.red/xyz -> https://app.redwood/webinars/avalon?utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=avalon_launch
follow-redirect -> https://app.redwood/webinars/avalon  (strips query params)
```
So the shortener strips query params on follow — that's our nulls.

sophie: ok that explains it. We lost UTM on a chunk of social traffic. Estimated impact: ~400 visits with ~0.7% attributed conversion vs 9% typical, explains the drop. I'll change the short link to preserve params and re-run the social push as a repost (minor).

mark: HubSpot audit quick note: no owner routing changes that would drop leads, but we did have duplicate suppression kick in for emails with plus-addressing. Not relevant to the null UTM group.

elaine: Great, thanks. I'll update the dashboard note: "conversion dip due to UTM-stripping short link on social — fix deployed, repost scheduled, numbers will normalize once attribution reconciles." Closing as "ops - benchline" and will do a follow-up snapshot on Monday. :white_check_mark:
